newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares barely changed in mixed trade.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares barely changed in mixed trade.

text.p: Istanbul shares ended mixed on Wednesday after trading in narrow ranges due to resistances seen at between the index's 1,600 and 1,650 levels and lack of market moving news, brokers said.

The IMKB National-100 closed two points, or 0.13 percent firmer at 1,592 after moving between 1,580 and 1,614. It lost 1.43 percent in profit-taking on Tuesday after leaping 3.93 percent on easing political concerns on Monday.
Trade volume increased to 27.38 trillion lira ($214.1 million) from Tuesday's 25.62 trillion ($200.8 million).

"Trade remained quiet because there is no positive expectation to move the market. Political uncertainty is still a negative factor, I expect trade to continue this way tomorrow," said Tolga Ozkan Okay from Evis securities.
